# DynaMac

> Mac notch HUD for Now Playing, Intent, and Shelf. Native macOS app by Surface Tension.

DynaMac (also found as Dynamac) is a free, open-source macOS utility that turns the MacBook notch into a HUD for music, calendar and focus (Intent), file holding (Shelf), and live Cursor/Claude/Codex agent status on Now Playing. Download the signed app from dynamac.com — tips optional.

## Links

- Website: https://dynamac.com
- Download: https://dynamac.com/api/download
- Tip (optional): https://dynamac.com/buy
- Changelog: https://dynamac.com/changelog
- Privacy: https://dynamac.com/privacy
- Terms: https://dynamac.com/terms
- Support: https://dynamac.com/support

## Product

- Platform: macOS 14 or later (Apple Silicon & Intel)
- Price: Free (open source); optional PayPal tip
- Tabs: Now Playing, Intent, Shelf
- Not included: cloud AI, screen recording, always-on microphone
